contexts.text: Like images of death sitting in torment.
They could be confirmed by the images... in the churches. HH 340.
The things of faith with these... are images with no life...
They who are in evils and falsities... thus act as images of life.
They become like images of death.
Like the external of man separated from his internal, which is an image with no life.
I saw a kind of image made by clergy from England, which represented faith alone... It was not unlike Dagon... TCR 810. LJPost 213.
Before the Angels (a natural moral man) if in good, appears like an image of wood; and if in truths, like an image of marble, in which there is no life.

Man's Own prudence appears as an image... The reason they are such images, is that evils and falsities are not alive... and as they know this from their rationality... they possess a vital human in their images.
He is an image who is a man only exteriorly.
The reason there are those who... worship images as gods, is...

Therefore... they formed for themselves images of gold, etc... in order that under these, as objects of sight, they might adore God. And others, who rejected images from religion, fashioned for themselves [ideal] images-imagines-from the sun, moon, and stars, and from various things upon the earth.
Instead of the woman, I saw hanging in that house an image, Described. AR 926.
Their descendants... began to worship as holy the images-imagines, and images set up by the Ancients...
The dogma of predestination... is like an image in the human form set up on a rock in the sea...
They no more hear than their images by the wayside.
(Charles XII) was almost like an image...
By imaginative things and images of correspondences...
When a man is in intellectual thought alone about God... he appears to the Angels as an image of ebony or of marble...
The Dutch... love a naked religion, without images... Not from images.
Without this free will, man... would be only a type and an image...
